nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control
nodes.description: Permission system using roles (admin, user) with separate dependencies for user and admin access.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting
nodes.description: Protection against abuse on sensitive endpoints, default 60 requests/minute.

nodes.label: Data Sanitization
nodes.description: External data must be cleaned before processing to prevent invalid data, malicious input, unexpected formats.

nodes.label: CORS Security
nodes.description: Cross-origin resource sharing configured for localhost:5173 (Vite dev server), no unrestricted access in production.

nodes.label: Security Guidelines
nodes.description: Security standards: secret management, authentication, input validation, CORS, file upload security.

nodes.label: No Raw Passwords
nodes.description: Never store plain passwords; always use secure hashing (bcrypt/Argon2).
